findings.title: [P2] Preserve empty-string results instead of applying a truthiness fallback
findings.body: For `{ name: "" }` or a whitespace-only name, `trim()` returns `""`. The previous nullish fallback preserved that valid result, whereas `name || "Anonymous"` replaces it with `"Anonymous"`. This changes the exported function’s observable contract; retain a nullish check unless this behavior change is intentional.
